question.text: The SEBI (Venture Capital Fund) Regulations were first notified in which year?

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI notified the SEBI (Venture Capital Fund) Regulations in 1996. This followed the Government of India's earlier 1988 venture capital guidelines and preceded the migration to the SEBI (AIF) Regulations, 2012. The Trap: 1988 is the year of the Government's pre-SEBI venture capital guidelines, not the SEBI VCF Regulations. 2012 is the year SEBI's AIF Regulations were notified. Note: The relevant timeline is 1988 (Government guidelines), 1996 (SEBI VCF Regulations) and 2012 (SEBI AIF Regulations) as stated in the workbook.
